styleRenderer: Soft Surface Lighting and Material Detail
audioDescription: Silent. No audio track; intentional silence for a style motion preview.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene; no specific historical vase-painting technique, workshop or period is claimed.
Burnished clay is approximated with procedural seeded value-noise roughness/normal maps; it is not a measured material.
Painted gloss is approximated by lowering roughness under painted texels; no layered slip or firing simulation.
Figure silhouettes and ornaments are authored primitives (arcs, strokes, Bezier paths), not traced from real vessels.
Frieze is authored for the body circumference (~r 210 svg px); figures compress slightly near the lower body where the radius shrinks.
Handles are TubeGeometry in plain terracotta, without painted decoration.
Neutral tone mapping slightly shifts lit/shadowed terracotta values; the albedo anchor stays #BA642F and the background clear color is exactly #100D09.
No ground plane or contact shadow, so the background stays uniform #100D09.
Preview covers about 90 degrees of rotation; the rest of the continuous narrative is shown only in the full video.
If WebGL context creation fails, the timeline still registers and the error is logged to the console ([style-125] Three.js scene unavailable); no substitute renderer is used.
Canvas 2D paints the wrap texture (4096x2048) as part of the Three.js renderer; the Three.js scene is bundled locally with esbuild into scene.bundle.js and the GSAP timeline is inline in index.html.
